findings.title: Collapsed project rows repeatedly sort every session
findings.what: LeafProjectRow unconditionally clones and sorts project.sessions before checking whether the row is expanded. ProjectBreakdownPf renders a leaf for every project and its expansion/show-all state updates re-render the parent, so each interaction repeats O(S log S) sorting across all rendered projects even though collapsed rows do not consume visibleSessions.
findings.fix: Defer session cloning and sorting until expanded is true, and memoize the result by project.sessions; derive visibleSessions and hasMore only for the expanded detail surface.
findings.acceptance: Add a component test proving that rendering many collapsed projects does not iterate or sort their session arrays, then prove expanding one project processes only that project's sessions while preserving newest-first order and Show all behavior.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed the unconditional clone/sort at src/components/ProjectBreakdown.tsx:163-169 occurs before the expanded-only detail block at line 270. Parent state for leaf/repository expansion and show-all is held at lines 548-575, and all leaves are recreated through renderLeaf at lines 582-600, so the repeated work is current and reproducible rather than speculative.
